product_brief: A commercial web server, reverse proxy, and load balancer with support for TLS, HTTP/3, and various security features.
pqc_capability_description: Not stated. The document mentions "NGINX Plus R33 PQC" in the platform title but the provided text contains no details on PQC algorithms, hybrid modes, or implementation status.

implementation_attack_surface: Buffer overflow in ngx_http_rewrite_module (CVE-2026-9256); heap memory buffer overflow in ngx_http_rewrite_module (CVE-2026-42945); heap memory buffer overread in ngx_http_scgi_module and ngx_http_uwsgi_module (CVE-2026-42946); heap memory buffer overread in ngx_http_charset_module (CVE-2026-42934); address spoofing in HTTP/3 connection migration (CVE-2026-40460); heap-use-after-free in ngx_http_ssl_module (CVE-2026-40701); plain text injection in upstream TLS proxying (CVE-2026-1642); buffer overflow in ngx_http_dav_module.

key_management_model: Supports Thales HSM authentication with custom signed certificates; supports Thales Luna HSM Universal Client v10.7.2; supports Certificate Management profiles.
primary_platforms: vCenter, NSX Cloud, Linux Server Cloud, VMware vSphere
signature_schemes: PQC signatures, RSA (implied by TLS_RSA ciphers), EC (implied by EC key handling)

pqc_capability_description: Supports NIST-compliant hybrid PQC ciphers SecP256r1ML-KEM-768 and SecP384r1ML-KEM-1024 (combining ECC and ML-KEM) and quantum secure VPN tunneling. Integrated into BIG-IP for app and network traffic protection without rearchitecting.
crypto_primitives: SecP256r1, SecP384r1, ML-KEM-768, ML-KEM-1024, RSA, ECC
primary_platforms: F5 Application Delivery and Security Platform (ADSP)
pqc_roadmap_details: Supports immediate transition using NIST-approved hybrid ciphers; designed for crypto agility to adapt to shifting standards.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Low friction; no rearchitecting apps or systems required; maintains high performance.
